params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: question  Priority: P2  Area: none (the demo and the pitch)
Summary: Decide which business process the demo narrative follows; the current demo follows a purchase order in Odoo, and the notes are not yet sure that is the most tangible story.

Source: Portal mail:29 (meeting notes on the demo, 2026-10-21).

The notes leave open which scenario narrative is the most tangible. Candidate areas listed: procurement, vendor onboarding, financial operations, insurance, compliance workflows, supply-chain operations, regulated purchasing, and later agent-to-agent commercial transactions.

A candidate pitch line came with that list: "AI agents that can act on behalf of organisations while remaining within verifiable boundaries of authority." Quoted verbatim as proposed copy; not yet adopted anywhere.

The live demo today runs a purchase order (procurement) through the gate on Odoo. Staying with procurement keeps everything on screen real; another domain means new demo data and flows. The question to answer: keep procurement and sharpen it (for example regulated purchasing), or move to another area.
params.title: Which business process should the demo narrative follow?
